answer: Time is the toll no farm can skip: 30 minutes per proof, 5070 minutes for 169, due every single epoch. A forged receipt fails at the first cross-check, because the issuer keeps a copy of its own. The farm practised the glacier, it practised the vault, but it never practised the plume, because a year cannot be practised. One threshold for every key: Etcher wood block proof engraved into the print room, and the same receipt, each wood block is a year of engraving logs in the line ledger, whoever holds the key.
